_comment: Applied by tools/gap-tests/gap.sh stack after the generator runs: what the ScenarioSpec cannot say yet.
AIRSIM_IMAGE: runtime host with the fisheye flare, veil, sensor-model and real-sun work (TEVV-Airsim #210-#216, unreleased).
ROS2_IMAGE: bridge v1.0.0 plus the image subscriber from TEVV-Airsim-ROS2-Bridge #75/#76 (tools/gap-tests/bridge-image).
DISABLE_RPC_AUX_SENSORS=false: ArduPilot needs the bridge's RPC GPS/baro/mag path.
TimeOfDay: the #216 real-sun keys; the generator only writes the older StartDateTime set. TimeZone defaults to round(lon/15).

ENABLE_VIO=true: with mns.vio_estimator declared the generator sets the bridge's enable_vio false, but on this bridge it also creates the fisheye camera_info publishers under the contract names (/fisheye_<cam>/camera_info); without it only /fisheye_<cam>_Scene/* exist.
